title: Perpetual chase of an unprotected cannon by a horse that attacks it from a fresh square each move
rationale: Red's horse alternates b4/d5 against the unprotected black cannon, attacking it on c3 from d5 and on d3 from b4 and attacking it from neither square before the move it makes, so every red move renews the chase under the accepted renewal rule and Red loses at the third occurrence. No ply is a check, which isolates the chase from perpetual check, and Black's cannon attacks no red man from either of its squares, which keeps the violation unilateral. This is also the deletion control for mx-mix-007: that fixture is these same eight plies with a red cannon added on d1, which turns every red move into a check as well without disturbing this chase, and it is here that the chase component of mx-mix-007 is shown to be a violation on its own.
